messages:
Ivy Nguyen: quick accessibility review of the Models table bulk action row. Noticed screen reader announcements are noisy when selecting multiple rows / the live region repeats counts on every click.
Marco Silva: can you paste the sequence you hear?
Ivy Nguyen: sure: '3 items selected' then when selecting a 4th it reads '3 items selected' then '4 items selected' twice sometimes. Seems like two updates to live region.
Tara Bennett: likely we update state twice (local + global). Debounce live region updates or update only on commit. Also ensure aria-live="polite" not assertive.
Marco Silva: good call. We currently update both selection state and selectedCount which trigger separate renders. I'll consolidate into a single setSelectedCount call inside the toggler.
Ivy Nguyen: also UX note: when keyboard selecting via Space, focus remains on the row not the bulk toolbar so screen reader users can't find the bulk actions. Should we move focus to toolbar when first item selected?
Tara Bennett: moving focus can be disruptive. Better: expose a skip-link-like affordance inside live region: 'X items selected. Press Tab to open selection actions.' and programmatically focus the first toolbar control only when user presses Enter on that hint or uses a dedicated shortcut.
Leo Park: agree. If we move focus automatically it may surprise users. Let's add an sr-only hint with instructions and add a keyboard shortcut (Shift+S) to focus the bulk toolbar.
a11y-bot: automated-check: live-region update frequency high, contrast of bulk toolbar button text vs bg = 3.1:1 (fails 4.5), focus outline width 2px flagged.
Ivy Nguyen: for contrast we'll switch toolbar text token to --text-strong and update button bg to --interactive-strong. For focus ring bump to 3px.
Marco Silva: implementation note: change live region update to be throttled at 250ms and ensure update only after selection state settles. Use requestIdleCallback fallback.
Tara Bennett: also ensure the live region content is concise: avoid repeating the full label. Use '4 items selected' only and avoid hidden duplicates.
Leo Park: shortcut implementation: register on keydown when list has focus; show a visually-hidden hint 'Press Shift+S to focus selection toolbar' when first item selected. Add aria-describedby linking row to hint.
a11y-bot: recommendation: add aria-atomic="true" to live region to ensure single coherent announcement.
Ivy Nguyen: good catch. Also audit VoiceOver rotor behaviour - on mac VO quicknav should find the toolbar controls under "landmarks" if we mark the toolbar role="toolbar" and give aria-label.
Marco Silva: will add role="toolbar" aria-label="Row selection actions" and ensure it's in DOM order after table header so logical nav finds it.
Tara Bennett: last small thing: screen reader reads 'Select all' checkbox as 'checkbox' not 'Select all' on Safari VO because the visible label is outside input. Ensure the checkbox is wrapped with <label> or use aria-labelledby.
Leo Park: noted. I'll rework markup to use <label for> and remove aria-label fallback unless necessary.
Ivy Nguyen: thanks team. Can someone add a cypress test that selects rows via Space and asserts live region text equals 'N items selected' and focus doesn't jump? Also include axe check for toolbar contrast.
Marco Silva: will open a draft PR with changes + test. Tagging @Tara for review.
Tara Bennett: happy to review. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
